synonyms: ペルソナ5アニメーション
description:
Ren Amamiya is about to enter his second year after transferring to Shujin Academy in Tokyo.
Following a particular incident, his Persona awakens, and together with his friends they form the “Phantom Thieves of Hearts” to reform hearts of corrupt adults by stealing the source of their distorted desires.
Meanwhile, bizarre and inexplicable crimes have been popping up one after another…
Living an ordinary high school life in Tokyo during the day, the group maneuvers the metropolitan city as Phantom Thieves after hours.
Let the curtain rise for this grand, picaresque story!

(Source: Official website)

node.description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9")
__Initial Persona:__  Arsène
__Ultimate Persona:__ ~!Satanael!~

The protagonist of Persona 5. He is a transfer student at Shujin High School and is infamous due to his criminal record. He was transferred to Shujin on probation by the court due to the alleged assault filed against him. During his probation, he lives in the cellar of Cafe Leblanc owned by Sakura Sojiro, which is also his acting guardian. 

Ren has a strong sense of justice, as noted by his fellow friends and confidants. He also has a strong will for rebellion, as noted by his Persona, Arsene. It is due to that strong will of rebellion that he could awaken his Persona and break free from the shackle of society. It is also noted by some people that Ren is very charismatic even though he appears as an unassuming and silent, sometimes airheaded person.

~!It is revealed that the case of assault filed against him was a setup to keep Masayoshi Shido's name clean for the upcoming election. The woman Shido sexually harassed and the one Ren tried to protect was forced to testify against him, saying that he indeed assault Shido.!~

__Birth Name:__ Futaba Isshiki
__Height:__ 152 cm
__Arcana:__ Hermit
__Initial Persona:__ Necronomicon
__Transforming Persona:__ Prometheus
__Fusion Persona:__ Al Azif

A genius 15-year-old​ girl with otherworldly calculation and programming skills. Her interpersonal communication is extremely poor though, so she lives life as a shut-in with limited to no human interaction.

alternative: Second Advent of the Detective Prince

node.description:
__Height:__ 178 cm (5'10")

Akechi is a high school student who conducts a detective business. His abilities as a detective have been widely acclaimed, since he not only has solved numerous cases but is also able to deal with people from the investigation agency smoothly. His handsome features draw public attention, and people comment on him as “The Second Advent of the Detective Prince.” He represents the Justice Arcana.

~!He works behind the scenes as the Black Mask responsible for many of the mental shutdown and psychotic breakdown incidents, acting as an assassin for [Shido](https://anilist.co/character/153729/Shido-Masayoshi)'s political gain.!~

__Height:__ 164 cm 
__Arcana:__ Priestess
__Initial Persona:__ Johanna
__Transforming Persona:__ Anat
__Fusion Persona:__ Agnes

Makoto is a perfectionist who has a strong sense of responsibility. Like her previous Priestess counterparts, Makoto is intelligent, honest, and very hardworking. In truth, she is a very compassionate and understanding young lady who strives to ensure everyone is accounted for. She is Shujin Academy's student council president and lives a double life as a Phantom Thief.

__Height:__ 175 cm
__Arcana:__ Chariot
__Initial Persona:__ Captain Kidd
__Transforming Persona:__ Seiten Taisei
__Fusion Persona:__ William

Ryuuji is known as a disruptive "problem student" at school whose bad behavior causes all sorts of trouble for the teachers. His rebellious, mischievous, and disobedient nature are the perfect qualities to be a Phantom Thief. He is a bit short-tempered, easily taking offense from even the slightest of comments from others, and can sometimes even resort to violence.

__Height:__ 181.9 cm
__Arcana:__ Emperor
__Initial Persona:__ Goemon
__Transforming Persona:__  Kamu Susano-o
__Fusion Persona:__ Gorokichi

Yusuke is a very composed and collected individual, and upon further inspection, this extends to a sense of methodical intelligence and a highly observant nature. He acts with poise and elegance, displayed by his eloquent, poetic way of speaking. He is able to remain calm even in dire circumstances, but can also act dramatically at times; others have pointed him out as weird, and even Yusuke admits that he can be seen as eccentric.

__Height:__ 168 cm
__Arcana:__ Lovers
__Initial Persona:__ Carmen
__Transforming Persona:__ Hecate
__Fusion Persona:__ Célestine

Ann Takamaki is a playable character from Persona 5. She is a student at Shujin Academy who lives a double life as a Phantom Thief. After being ridden with guilt of not helping her best friend Shiho Suzui who would fall victim to Suguru Kamoshida and would lose ties with her in the process, she would support her friends while facing, overcoming, and promising not to make the same mistake again.

__Height:__ 158 cm
__Arcana:__ Empress
__Initial Persona:__ Milady
__Transforming Persona:__ Artarte
__Fusion Persona:__ Lucy

Haru has good communication and observational skills. She grew up with all the elegance and splendor. She finds it difficult to differentiate between those who truly value her as a friend and who merely want to use her for her family's status. After meeting and joining the Phantom Thieves, Haru becomes passionate and rebellious and eventually learns how to properly convey her mind and connect with others.
Tae Takemi is a back alley doctor who owns a clinic in Yongen-Jaya, not far from Cafe Leblanc.

__Height:__ 60 cm (Bipedal) - 50 cm (Cat, including tail)
__Initial Persona:__ Zorro
__Transforming Persona:__ Mercurius
__Fusion Persona:__ Diego

Morgana is an amnesiac that remembers almost nothing about his past or himself, believing that the cause is the distortions within Mementos. This causes him to lose his sense of self in the process and wishes to get it back. Despite his appearance of a mysterious cat-like creature, he believes himself to have been human. He theorizes the core of Mementos may have the answers, but access from most of it is blocked and he cannot go very deep. In order to achieve his goal, he began to investigate the Metaverse and checked on numerous Palaces for clues.

~!Before being imprisoned and replaced by Yaldabaoth, Igor created Morgana out of the last remaining traces of human hope, and his role is to assist the protagonist in his journey.!~

She is a Japanese teacher and homeroom teacher of Class 2-D at Shujin Academy. She is shown to be very cautious and act coldly towards Ren Amamiya due to the fact that he has a criminal record to him and thought of him as nothing but a problem student, even going as far as asking for homeroom reassignment at first. She is symbolized by The Temperance tarot card.

~!She secretly works a side job as a Call-out Maid during the night, going by the alias of Becky. She and Ren make a deal to keep her maid identity a secret and in return she will help Ren in many ways like allowing him to slack off in class. Eventually, she and Ren develop a dependent friendship with each other and Ren helps her with quitting her job as a maid to allow her to restart her life as a brand new teacher.!~

Sae is the older sister and legal guardian of Makoto Niijima since their father's murder a few years ago. Sae works as a Public Prosecutor of the Tokyo District Special Investigation Department at the Public Prosecutors Office. 

Sae is intelligent, professional and serious, although her actual maturity is debatable. A workaholic, Sae is very strict in both her work as prosecutor and guardian for her younger sister, Makoto, constantly telling her to focus on her studies and such. With many responsibilities, Sae is always working due to Japan's work pressure, and is very stressed and exhausted. She must care for Makoto, almost putting her in a single mother's role. Her father's ideals, who died in the line of duty, is her sore spot. She resents him for throwing his life away in the name of justice, to the point that when Makoto asks for her opinion on whether he would think the Phantom Thieves of Hearts were just, Sae snaps and says a bunch of cruel things that she instantly regrets, up to and including that she views Makoto as a burden. 

(Source: Megami Tensei Wiki)

Hifumi is a young lady who attends Kosei High School. She holds the championship title in the Female Shogi League. Her appearance has gained her attention as the "too beautiful shogi player". She practices hard and gives interviews every day for the sake of her mother and for the world of shogi.

Sojiro Sakura is the manager of Cafe Leblanc in Yongen-Jaya. He oversees the care of the protagonist during his probation in Tokyo.
~! He is Futaba Sakura's adoptive father. !~

A mysterious, long-nosed gentleman who resides in the Velvet Room. 

As in the other Persona games, Igor's purpose is to assist the player in acquiring new powers and Persona.
Munehisa Iwai is the owner of the airsoft shop "Untouchable" in Shibuya.
Justine appears to be calm and soft-spoken but still treats Ren Amamiya as her prisoner, often addressing him in a condescending tone.

Caroline has a very classical tsundere attitude towards Ren Amamiya. She tends to speak to Justine in a demeaning manner. Additionally, she doesn't seem to hold Ren in very high regard, as she refers to him as "inmate".
~!Lavenza is the true form of Caroline and Justine, she appears at the end of the story when Caroline and Justine remember they're actually two parts of her.!~
Mishima is a second year high school student at Shujin Academy and classmate of Ren Amamiya and Ann Takamaki in class 2-D.

Chihaya is a tarot fortune-teller who runs a fortune-telling stand in Shinjuku. She has a bright and cheerful atmosphere about her, but her fortunes always hit the mark. She is rumored to definitely be “a real fortune-teller,” but at the same time, apparently recommends these “suspicious stones".

Ooya is a paparazzi in her mid-20s. She will write whatever story sells, even sometimes manipulating and twisting the information in her articles for the sake of clickbait and attention, and even if it means she does not have to take the time to properly research the truth.
Shinya is an elementary school boy who plays at the Gigolo arcade of Akihabara, and is known as the gaming genius called "The King".
Shiho is Ann Takamaki's best and only friend at Shujin Academy.

Alice is said to be based off of Lewis Carroll's (Reverend Charles Lutwidge Dodgson) character from his famous story Alice In Wonderland. The Shin Megami Tensei Alice shares many physical similarities with the character, most notably the blue dress and the blond hair. Also, her signature move "Die For Me!" seems to draw inspiration from the book, as it features spear-wielding cards. Furthermore, her Shin Megami Tensei: IMAGINE attack, "Mad Tea Party", takes further inspiration from the book as it references the chapter in which the protagonist met the Mad Hatter and March Hare.  However, some say that she is also based off of a myth of an Aryan girl who died at a young age. When Alice died and became a spirit, she gained extreme magical power that drove her insane. Alice was used to scare Scandinavian children into behaving, or else Alice would visit them at night and kill them so that she may become "friends" with them. Due to the overwhelming support of both theories, it is easy to assume both are valid and that she is a hybrid of both figures. That both are valid seems to be the case though, since the Strange Journey Compendium hints at both.   *Taken from MegamiTensei.wikia.com/wiki/Alice
Toranosuke Yoshida is attempting to seriously enter Japan's political system in order to start changing the country, but is having difficulties doing so.

She is shown to be a very carefree and energetic idol, making various catchphrases about food subjects to fit the Kanamin Kitchen theme, although she seems to be self-conscious about her weight. Kanami appears to be friendly and kind toward Rise.
Kobayakawa is the principal of Shujin Academy.

Masayoshi Shido is a politician who has been a metropolitan assemblyman and a representative in the National Diet of Japan. He is now a cabinet minister who split from the ruling party to form the United Future Party and is running for election of the next Prime Minister of Japan.
~!Secretly, however, he is the founder of a conspiracy to obtain power by any means necessary, and is backed by Yaldabaoth, as Shido's ascent to power would cement authoritarian control over Japan and possibly the world.!~

~! Wakaba Isshiki was Futaba Sakura's mother and a prominent cognitive researcher focusing on a supernatural phenomenon about the cognitive world within the human's mind which she titled "Cognitive psience". She was very brilliant and talented in this field of study. She gave birth to Futaba out of wedlock and was her sole parent and caretaker prior to her death. !~

Kamoshida is a former professional athlete and Olympic volleyball champion who later became the volleyball coach of Shujin Academy. During his time as a teacher, Kamoshida's fame was used as a means to give Shujin Academy and its students more publicity, be it for scholarships or college applications.
~!His ego, inflated by the clear favoritism of Principal Kobayakawa, caused him to sabotage other Shujin Academy sports teams, forcing most to disband so the volleyball team would remain at the forefront. One of the casualties of this campaign was the track team; during his coaching, Kamoshida purposefully goaded them, eventually intentionally provoking one of the top team members, Ryuji Sakamoto, into violence, allowing him to break Ryuji's leg in an apparent case of "self-defense" resulting in the subsequent disbanding of the team.!~

Lala Escargot works as the proprietor of Bar Crossroads in Shinjuku. Lala is a close confidant to Ohya, who regularly visits Crossroads to converse with Lala about her job and her investigation of Kayo. Though they have a playfully temperamental relationship and frequently exchange jabs, Lala is one of the few people who Ohya trusts.

Madarame is a famous artist who has mentored many students, many of which lived with him in his humble shack near Shibuya.
~!The shack is not his real home and is merely used to hide is true intentions; his real home is actually much more refined and registered under his mistress' name.!~

Kaneshiro is a mafia boss who rose in the criminal underworld through clever use of blackmail. Even the police cannot do anything against him due to him being highly elusive and well-guarded along with his vast wealth reserves.
Kunikazu Okumura is Haru Okumura's father. He is the third president of Okumura Foods succeeded from his father. He also founded Big Bang Burger, a fast food chain.
Sugimura is the fiance of Haru Okumura. Like Haru, he is also extremely wealthy and comes from a rich and influential political family.
As the director of Special Investigations Unit, he leads an elite team of police and prosecutors that deal with government scandals and other huge cases.
